espocrm-0.description: EspoCRM is an open-source web application designed to build loyal relationships with customers and boost your sales. The software creates a unified collaborative place for your employees with all the necessary data inside - customer profiles and communications with them, information about opportunities, sales orders, invoices & quotes. It allows to streamline the sales processes, automate routine operations, create personalized marketing campaigns and provide top quality customer service.

product-videos-woocommerce.description: Instantly Find and Embed Videos for all the products you sell, from all the major media websites including YouTube, Facebook and Vimeo. Display embedded media as the Product Featured Video or in a custom tab. You can automate the entire process and you have detailed control over which videos show on which products. Get Started for Free!

kissmetrics-shopify.description: Kissmetrics is a solution for customer analytics and this integration is an easy and cost-effective way to integrate. ayedeals.description: AyeDeals allows users to search 100s of e-commerce sites in a matter of seconds. The application utilizes multiple APIs, some of them include Etsy, Sears, Best Buy Products,..and more.

online-basketball-camp.description: Online Basketball Camp (also referred to as Hoop Alert) is a website for coaches to manage and communicate with their teams by providing a custom platform for scheduling, text messaging, video uploading, and more. Content on Izik is presented in various categories to allow for minimal typing and to provide context to results. For example, users can look up Jennifer Lopez and see results under the categories of Lyrics, Gossip, and Perfume.

sos-garage.description: SOS Garage is a french Android app that uses the Allogarage API to help find auto garages that are reliable in a users area.
